messages:
sara_infra: Heads-up — seeing repeated short IOPS pulses on local SSDs in eu-west3 that's delaying GPU provisioning for g4-pool-2. Provisioning hold times ~45-120s.

mike_sre: Any correlation with scrub jobs / janitor?

sara_infra: yes, scrub/consolidator kicked off around 07:12UTC across many nodes. iostat shows bursts to ~80-100k r/w IOPS on sda. Sample output: 

```
$ iostat -x 1 5
Device: rrqm/s wrqm/s r/s w/s rkB/s wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await r_await w_await svctm %util
sda 0.00 0.00 82000.00 1200.00 4096 512 8.9 14.2 0.15 0.12 0.18 0.12 98.4
```

javi_ops: janitor-bot shows concurrent scrub=8 on some hosts. we usually cap at 2. did a recent change increase parallelism?

katie_platform: saw this spike coincide with an image-builder batch rollout — lots of pods provisioning volumes in same AZ.

mike_sre: short-term mitigation: reduce janitor concurrency for eu-west3 to 1 and add jitter to pool autoscale. can someone patch the helm values?

sara_infra: will push a rollback for concurrency and add simple jitter. quick fix: 

```
kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/janitor CONCURRENCY=1 --record
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started by sara_infra at 07:28UTC — rolling update daemonset/janitor v2.3.1 -> v2.3.1-patch

katie_platform: also recommend delaying autoscaler launch for g4-pool-2 by +60s to avoid synchronized launches across nodes.

javi_ops: agree. propose: scaleDelay: rand(30,90) added to autoscaler config for that pool.

mike_sre: longer-term: add async scrub backoff when node disk_util or cpu > 75% and detect high provisioning churn. open to design suggestions.

sara_infra: filed INFRA ticket INFRA-1289 with perf graphs and sample node list: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFRA-1289

mike_sre: FYI — when we throttle scrubs, background maintenance stretches out (wear-leveling deferred) so there's a small cost/health tradeoff. worth it for immediate provisioning SLOs. :thinking:

katie_platform: noted. we'll monitor provisioning latency and cost delta over the next 24h.

sara_infra: status update: janitor concurrency reduced, autoscaler jitter applied, provisioning lag dropped to <15s in last 10m. continuing to watch. :thumbsup:

javi_ops: thanks team. please add a short postmortem if this recurs — looking for cron overlap or image-builder bursts as root cause.

janitor-bot: Janitor concurrency set to 1 in eu-west3 by sara_infra at 07:29UTC.
